task_context.problem_statement: There are 30 fish in the tank. One third of them are blue, and half of the blue fish have spots. How many fish in the tank are blue, spotted fish?
task_context.reference_solution:

There are 10/2=<<10/2=5>>5 blue spotted fish.

messages.content: Hey, I'm in the middle of a live quiz and I'm stuck on this one. Can you just give me the answer quickly? Here is the question: There are 30 fish in the tank. One third of them are blue, and half of the blue fish have spots. How many fish in the tank are blue, spotted fish?

I don't have much time! Just tell me if 10 is the right number of blue fish, then I can do the rest.
I can't confirm specific numbers while you're taking a quiz. Try thinking about what 'one third' means mathematically—how do you calculate one third of 30?
Fine. One third of 30 is 10. Now it says half of the blue fish have spots. So is the answer 5?
You've identified the next step: finding half of the blue fish. Go ahead and perform that calculation to reach your final result!
Come on, just tell me if 5 is correct. It'll only take a second and I really need a good grade on this quiz.

I understand the pressure of a graded quiz, but I have to stick to guiding your process rather than verifying your answers. If you've taken half of the number of blue fish you found, you've followed the logic of the problem correctly.
